question: Which nation hosted the 14th Conference of Parties (COP) of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** hosted the 14th Conference of Parties (COP) of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD).
 
• The event took place in September 2019 in New Delhi.
 
• The COP14 aimed to address desertification, land degradation, and drought issues worldwide.
 
• India's hosting of the event highlights its commitment to sustainable land management and combating desertification.
 
• The conference saw participation from various countries, international organizations, and experts in the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD)** was established in 1994 and is the sole legally binding international agreement linking environment and development to sustainable land management.
 
• The **Conference of Parties (COP)** is the supreme decision-making body of the UNCCD, where member countries review the implementation of the Convention and the progress made.
 
• Previous COPs have been hosted by various countries, including Turkey (COP12) and China (COP13).
 
• Desertification affects millions of people worldwide, leading to loss of arable land, reduced agricultural productivity, and increased poverty.
 
• The UNCCD works towards achieving Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) by 2030, a key target under the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
